description: A React component for displaying and managing a list of group members in a popover, including features like infinite scrolling, user status display, and direct messaging.

methods.name: GroupMemberList
methods.description: React component rendering a list of group members with infinite scroll, user status, and direct message functionality.

methods.name: loadNextPage
methods.description: Fetches the next page of users in the group.

methods.name: showDirectChannel
methods.description: Opens a direct message channel to the selected user and navigates to it.

methods.name: isUserLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a user at a given index has been loaded.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Renders individual list items, either user entries or loading indicators.

methods.name: renderContent
methods.description: Determines what content to display based on search and loading states.
